title: AINumbers MCP server card (mcp-server-card-v1)
description: Authored in-house, 2026-09-21. Field vocabulary follows the SEP-1649 'MCP Server Cards' draft (github.com/modelcontextprotocol, retrieved 2026-09-21 — no canonical schema URL exists yet; static.modelcontextprotocol.io/schemas/mcp-server-card/v1.json 404s as of 2026-09-21) and the official date-versioned MCP server schemas (static.modelcontextprotocol.io/schemas/2025-12-11/server.schema.json, verified HTTP 200 on 2026-09-21). No bytes copied from either source. The canonical copy lives here, beside openchain-graph-v0.4.schema.json; a byte-identical served twin lives at .well-known/mcp/server-card.schema.json (drift-gated by scripts/check-server-card-schema.mjs). Validation keywords are deliberately limited to type/required/const/enum/pattern/minLength/minimum — the estate's zero-dependency validator implements exactly these. Mechanism credit: server-card discipline inspired by GREP AI (Parcha Labs — https://grep.ai) public surface, 2026-09-21; ideas only.
